instruction: Look at guih16_fire_evacuation_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. For this task, launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih16_fire_evacuation_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard fire evacuation plan and delete all GUIDE entities before saving. Draw WALL segments (0,0)-(6800,0), (7600,0)-(8000,0), (8000,0)-(8000,5000), (8000,5000)-(0,5000), (0,5000)-(0,0), (2600,0)-(2600,1300), (2600,2100)-(2600,5000), (5200,0)-(5200,2500), (5200,3300)-(5200,5000), (0,2500)-(5200,2500), and (6000,2500)-(8000,2500). Keep WALL clear across the 800 mm door-opening spans (2600,1300)-(2600,2100), (5200,2500)-(5200,3300), (5200,2500)-(6000,2500), and (6800,0)-(7600,0). Add DOOR arcs of radius 800 with center/start/end angles (2600,2100)/270/360 degrees, (5200,2500)/0/90 degrees, and (7600,0)/90/180 degrees. Insert EXTINGUISHER blocks at (1200,1200), (4200,3700), and (7000,1600). Draw EXIT arrows (1200,1200)-(300,300), (4200,3700)-(3900,4900), and (7000,1600)-(7800,300). Add EXIT labels, FIRE EVAC PLAN title, and LEGEND: F = EXTINGUISHER. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih16_fire_evacuation_completed.dxf.
